Sportsbooks disagree on prices. That's where arbitrage comes from. Example: Book A has Over 221.5 total points at +140. Book B has the Under at −125. Bet $214 on the Over and $286 on the Under. Whichever side hits, you get back $513.60 or $514.80 on $500, so you keep $13.60 or $14.80, if both bets are placed at these prices. Most arbs are small: usually 3% or less of what you stake. They also disappear fast. OddsBoss scans 17 books and markets, pre-match and live, shows the pair as soon as it opens and gives you the exact bet size for each side. You don't need to follow the team, or even the sport. See how it works: https://macaroniidev.github.io/oddsboss/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=page_launch&utm_content=P1#how Example only. No bet is guaranteed. 21+ only. Gambling problem? Call 1-800-GAMBLER. OddsBoss is software, not a sportsbook.

Some bets pay out more than they should. Positive EV finds them. OddsBoss prices every bet against sharp, no-vig fair odds and ranks them by edge in real time, pre-match and live. Sportsbooks limit sharp bettors. So they bet big on Novig and ProphetX, where every bet is public. When volume spikes on a line there, OddsBoss Sharp Money finds the best price for the same bet at your books and tells you exactly what and how much to bet. It follows whole lines (like LeBron over 20 points), not single bettors, and works on US sportsbooks and fantasy apps. These are one-sided bets, so you will lose some. It's best for anyone willing to open 3+ sportsbook accounts, fund them with $1,000+ and put in 1+ hour a day. Sharp Money is $79.99/mo. 7 days free.
